settings.heading: Twelve brands we'd give our own kids
settings.text: Every brand here is distributed in Australia by Coolkidz, with local stock, Australian warranty and one support team. Shop them together here, or visit each brand's own site.

settings.heading: Meet the brands
settings.text: Shop a brand's range here, or head to its own Australian website.

settings.name: UPPAbaby
settings.story: Prams, capsules and nursery pieces designed around how families actually live. Distributed, warranted and serviced in Australia by Coolkidz.

settings.name: Nanit
settings.story: Overhead HD baby monitors with sleep tracking, plus breathing motion monitoring through the night, all in the Nanit app.

settings.name: Gaia Baby
settings.story: Cots, dressers and nursing chairs like the Eos range, made to grow with your child from the first night.

settings.name: WonderFold
settings.story: Stroller wagons that seat two to six children, from the W2 to the W6, with room for everything else too.

settings.name: Magic
settings.story: Odour-free nappy bins with a twist-and-seal system and no refill cartridges.

settings.name: Frida
settings.story: Practical care for babies and new mums, from the NoseFrida to the hospital birth kit.

settings.name: ZAZU
settings.story: Sleep trainer clocks, nightlights, projectors and white noise for babies and toddlers.

settings.name: MiaMily
settings.story: Carry-on and check-in suitcases with a built-in seat, so little ones can ride through the airport.

settings.name: smarTrike
settings.story: The Wonder range of folding stroller-trikes, plus scooters that grow with your child.

settings.name: Mamave
settings.story: Gentle skincare for mum and baby, from Mumma's Oil to Bubba's Wash.

settings.name: Matchstick Monkey
settings.story: Teething toys and first toothbrushes shaped for small hands and sore gums.

settings.name: Hannie
settings.story: A portable high chair that packs down to go wherever you eat.

settings.quote: Have had my pram for 6yrs and used for all 3 of my children. I have many accessories that have made my life so much easier on many occasions. This is the only pram anybody needs!!
settings.name: Eva J.

settings.quote: Great bin, no smell and love that you can use it one handed unlike other brands we’ve tried
settings.name: Hayley B.

settings.quote: Second Gaia mattress I’ve purchased and am pleased with how it fits the bed, and the low-toxin materials.
settings.name: Alyssa H.

settings.quote: Best investment for travel. Everyone we saw waiting in the huge airport line asked me where I got the suitcases from.
settings.name: EC

settings.quote: Love this high chair, the way it compacts is ideal to take everywhere with you. If we go on holidays it fits in our carry on luggage and it’s perfect for growing bubs!
settings.name: Bree

settings.quote: Our son used to get distracted when room sharing. Now it's like his own little tent. He sleeps so much better!
settings.name: Benjamin

settings.quote: Great capsule. Easy to use, reasonably light weight. Clips on easy to the vista and minu (minu needs adaptors). Baby enjoys riding in it.
settings.name: Luca

settings.quote: Love the cover it makes it so much easier to travel with and compact especially inside the back of the tray as we don’t have a boot
settings.name: Chloe M.
